summary: Single Secure Agility camera (322) covering 12 zones at Gipps St / Broughton St, Concord, from June 2024; it has only one counter so each counter-direction is its own series. The camera publishes explicit zeros around outages (2025-10-02 PM, 2025-11-10, 2026-08-05 AM, and the partial last day 2026-09-24), and those days are set missing; zero_outage fixes on the near-empty zone 497 and on storm days are restored. A step change around 2024-09-26 (level +70%, a changed zone split, and IN/OUT no longer balanced) makes the first four months uncertain.
